content.title: Trump Administration Moves to Accelerate AI Power Hookups
content.summary: US Energy Secretary Chris Wright urged the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission on Thursday to grant expedited reviews for data-center grid connections, according to documents reviewed by Bloomberg News.  Under a draft proposed rule Wright sent to the agency, those reviews would be limited to 60 days, a seismic shift for a process that currently can drag on for years.

content.summary: Buzzy nuclear power stocks may have found a new narrative to keep their rally going: Defense contracting.  The Army announced a nuclear power initiative on Tuesday called the Janus Program, which it described as an effort to “deliver resilient, secure, and assured energy to support national defense installations and critical missions.”  The program will build small nuclear reactors, which will be commercially owned and operated.
